messages.subject: Project Onyx - final cap table and funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
Rohan,

Attached are the agreed pre/post-money capitalisation table and the completion funds flow for Project Onyx. Headline numbers: £24m new money (Calderbrook £18m / Ravensworth £6m) at £12.00 per share, 2,000,000 new Series B shares, post-money £96m, investors holding 25 per cent fully diluted. Net proceeds to the company after capped costs are on the funds flow. Please confirm the company's account details.

Elena

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
